install.notes: The clone needs the separate AirSim and JSBSim installs and a local JSBSim aircraft directory (README.md:6-10); its Simulation root is the hardcoded Windows path of src/jsbsim_simulator.py:76. setup.py:23 uses a set literal for package_dir, so pip install . is not relied on to expose src/envs. The fake backend needs none of this, and the gate never installs or imports the upstream package.
